name: Ekin Ingebrigtsen
role: Social engineering and negotiation specialist — face
location: Glassway — corporate-adjacent retail district, heavy surveillance, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Ekin Ingebrigtsen is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in GLMZ, the distinction is academic. At 45, his face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains) — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He came up through the Gray Zone's informal apprentice system, learning the trade from runners who didn't survive long enough to see him surpass them. He works as a face out of Glassway, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Ekin Ingebrigtsen operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
blind_spots: Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
psychology.secret: Sagyn Brandt-Ouedraogo can't read. Hides it behind voice interfaces and memorization. The shame is older than the chrome.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Never uses contractions when lying — 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
example_lines: "People want to trust someone. I just make sure that someone is me."
"The hardest lock to pick is between someone's ears."
"I don't lie. I tell a better version of the truth."

story_hooks: Sagyn Brandt-Ouedraogo is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Sagyn Brandt-Ouedraogo owes a personal debt to
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Sagyn Brandt-Ouedraogo's reputation — and a price for silence
narrative_function: Sagyn Brandt-Ouedraogo represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains). Reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
breaking_points: Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously

physical_description.heritage: Middle Eastern-East Asian-Southeast Asian diaspora blend. The result is a striking phenotype: warm bronze-gold skin with subtle golden undertones from the dominant East Asian and Southeast Asian ancestry (56.5% combined), enriched and deepened by the substantial Middle Eastern component (43.5%). High, prominent cheekbones and sharp jawline reflect the combined East Asian and Middle Eastern bone structure. Eye shape shows blended traits across all three ancestry groups, with the characteristic depth and dark intensity of Middle Eastern heritage combined with the East Asian eye geometry and Southeast Asian warmth. The overall effect is an angular, high-definition face with warm, sun-responsive skin that reads as distinctly pan-Asian with Mediterranean depth.
physical_description.build: Athletic and lean — muscular without bulk, the functional frame of someone who trains for speed and endurance rather than mass. Defined shoulders and forearms suggest years of precision work; core is visibly tight.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading at temples and along the sides
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and practical, swept back from the face with minimal product — a style that doesn't require maintenance mid-job
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with amber flecks; alert, constantly reading micro-expressions
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm bronze-gold complexion — the result of blended East Asian, Southeast Asian, and Middle Eastern ancestry. The East Asian and Southeast Asian components (56.5% combined) provide the warm golden base, while the Middle Eastern ancestry (43.5%) deepens the tone to bronze. Deepens noticeably with sun exposure.
physical_description.complexion: Angular facial structure with high, prominent cheekbones and sharp jawline characteristic of East Asian and Middle Eastern heritage, softened by Southeast Asian warmth. Skin is scarred but not deeply — the kind of minor damage that comes from close-quarters work. Light stubble usually present; grooming is functional, not aesthetic. Crow's feet around the eyes from squinting and stress.
distinguishing_marks: Circular scar tissue pattern on the right temple and extending behind the ear — site of cortical bomb removal, approximately 4cm diameter, pale and matte against surrounding skin
Thin white scar across the left knuckle ridge, old and faded
Burn mark on the inside of the right wrist, size of a cigarette, deliberately hidden when wearing long sleeves
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cortical bomb removal scar is immediately visible and unmissable — carries implicit threat: survived something most runners don't walk away from. Spinal reflex boosters are not visible externally, though those familiar with chrome can spot the slight rigidity in his posture that betrays subcutaneous wiring along the spine.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical grace — no wasted motion, every gesture calibrated. Stands with weight distributed for rapid directional change. Eyes track exits and sight lines automatically. When sitting, shoulders remain loose but alert; when speaking to targets, he leans in slightly, voice controlled and measured. Right hand moves slightly slower than left (old injury accommodation). Breathes from the diaphragm — boxer's breathing, controlled and deep.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 streetwear with corporate-adjacent polish. Favors fitted charcoal or dark gray tactical jackets with subtle armor weave — visible stitching patterns indicate high-end fabrication. Underneath: clean, well-fitted shirts in neutral colors, often with subtle data-port access panels at the wrists. Dark fitted trousers with reinforced seams and concealed pockets. Chrome or matte black boots, expensive but worn in. Accessories minimal: worn leather cuff on left wrist (covers augmentation port), stainless steel watch with analog face (no wireless vulnerability), encrypted data chip on a thin chain under his shirt. No jewelry. The overall effect is 'expensive enough to be credible, unremarkable enough to move through Tier 3-4 spaces unnoticed.'
